content:
Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia
+385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

Dear FreshCart Hiring Team,

I’m applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at your Zagreb-Jarun store. I have nine years of experience in butchery and meat-counter work, along with completed vocational butcher training and HACCP certification.

In my current role at Mesnica Kod Ante, I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat for the counter, and make several kinds of fresh sausage using the shop’s recipes. I also record cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice a day. My customer-service experience includes advising people on cuts and cooking times, and I’ve trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines. I’d be glad to bring that practical experience and care for hygiene to FreshCart’s staffed meat counter.

I can start after a two-month notice period. I’d welcome the chance to talk about how my experience could contribute to your team.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

critique.content_quality_feedback: The cover letter is concise, natural and professional, matching the user's request for a non-stiff writing style. It clearly states the role, nine years of relevant experience, butcher training, HACCP certification, core butchery duties, customer advice and apprentice training. The structure is easy to scan and the two-month notice period is communicated clearly. Its main limitation is that it could demonstrate impact more strongly by including the candidate's documented Saturday customer volume and using slightly more of the employer's wording around HACCP records and fresh-meat counter work.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The letter uses ATS-friendly plain text, standard contact details, a conventional greeting and readable paragraphs. Relevant terms such as butcher, meat counter, vocational butcher training, HACCP, fresh sausage, beef, pork, bone, trim, portion and customer service are present. AI/ATS screening probability is high for the stated must-have requirements. Minor keyword coverage could improve by using the exact phrases "fresh meat for the service counter" and "HACCP records"; the letter does not and should not claim unsupported experience with FIFO, packaging, self-service shelves or forklift operation.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is very strong. The letter shows the completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience required by the advert, as well as HACCP-related temperature-recording experience. It addresses cutting, portioning, customer advice, hygiene and reliability-related responsibilities. The candidate's documented experience serving approximately 120 customers on a Saturday would further support fit for a busy supermarket counter. Forklift licence is not mentioned in the candidate information, so this is a gap rather than a document defect.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT 1 — In the second paragraph, strengthen the meat-counter wording by changing "I break down beef and pork, bone, trim and portion meat for the counter" to "I break down beef, pork and lamb carcasses, bone, trim and portion fresh meat for the service counter." This uses the job advert's terminology while remaining supported by the original candidate information.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 2 — In the customer-service section of the second paragraph, add the documented volume from the original candidate information: "In my current role, I also serve about 120 customers on a Saturday, advising them on cuts and cooking times." This gives the letter a concrete measure of performance in a busy counter environment.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 3 — Replace "I also record cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice a day" with "I maintain HACCP records by recording cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice a day." This makes the HACCP relevance more explicit without adding unsupported duties.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or ≥ 2 years at a meat counter
requirements.quote: I have nine years of experience in butchery and meat-counter work, along with completed vocational butcher training.
I also record cold-room and display-counter temperature checks twice a day.
